description: This data set holds 2014 input data for a European power flow and market model in PowerGAMA (Power Grid and Market Analysis), a lightweight open-source Python package from SINTEF Energy Research that uses linear programming to optimise generator dispatch by marginal cost at each time step for large interconnected power systems. The data were published by Eirik Rye and Arne Lie, updated substantially from earlier work, and use only publicly available data so that the whole model stays open. The approach and simplifications are explained in a validation study of an approximate 2014 European power flow model submitted to IET. Coverage is the European interconnected system for the year 2014. The data are one RAR archive of about 6 MB on Zenodo (June 2016) under CC0 at no cost, for use with PowerGAMA from its Bitbucket repository. Caveats: the model is an approximation of the 2014 grid built from public data, and it is now dated. Simulation uses are European power flow and dispatch simulation and teaching or benchmarking of market models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
